data.long_meaning: Bhati is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhaga', which refers to the Hindu god of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name symbolizes abundance, riches, and material success. The name Bhati carries the meaning “God of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhati usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
